wrap_environment_terminal_logging: wrap a bsuite environment with terminal logging that pretty prints step data to stderr
create_logger_terminal: create a Logger instance that writes data to terminal with optional pretty printing and absl logging
pretty_dict_format: format a dictionary into a readable string with sorted keys separated by pipe characters
value_format_number: format a numeric value as an integer or fixed point float string for display
logger_write_data: write a mapping of data to terminal using the Logger write method with pretty printing
